name: Eleos
short_description: AI documentation for community behavioral health agencies: notes drafted in a sidebar over the agency's web EHR, plus note compliance review. Sold by demo.
long_description: Eleos is AI documentation and workflow software sold to community behavioral health organizations, substance use treatment providers and care-at-home agencies, not to individual clinicians. Its main product, Scribe, drafts notes and session summaries and gives leadership reporting; Eleos says it can work without recording the session, while Replay adds consented session recordings and transcripts for supervision. Outreach is a mobile tool for field-based case managers that works offline and syncs notes to the EHR later, and Eleos Compliance reviews eligible notes for compliance risk. Eleos runs as a browser-extension sidebar over any web-based EHR rather than through custom API builds; named EHRs include CareLogic, Credible, InSync, SmartCare, myAvatar NX, myEvolv, EchoVantage, PCE, Kipu, Welligent, eHana and Exym. The vendor lists support for over 150 languages, HIPAA compliance, HITRUST certification, SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, with data on HIPAA-eligible AWS servers in the US. Pricing is not published.
one_liner: AI notes and compliance review for community behavioral health agencies, on top of their EHR.
best_for: Community mental health centers and CCBHCs that want AI notes inside an existing web EHR
Agencies on CareLogic, Credible, SmartCare, myAvatar NX, myEvolv or Kipu
Organizations with field-based case managers who document offline
Quality and compliance teams that want every eligible note reviewed for risk
not_for: Solo or small private practices; Eleos sells to organizations by demo
Clinicians who want published pricing or a self-serve trial
Practices whose EHR is a desktop application rather than web-based
